statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. The Labor Day equity-index trading break leaves no current NQ price path to establish persistent mean-reversion failure; geopolitical and oil risk keep the external backdrop severe.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail remains below the blocking threshold during the holiday break; the next structural checkpoint is gap repair versus repeated extension after the 22:00 UTC futures reopen.
headline: Holiday break keeps Tail at upper WATCH; reopen price discovery is the next structural test
body: U.S. holiday trading was light, with Reuters reporting Nasdaq futures about 0.2% higher before the break. CME equity-index matching is now halted. Brent was near six-week highs as U.S.-Iran maritime escalation and constrained Hormuz traffic sustained extreme Stress without current evidence of a persistent one-way NQ path.

outlookSummary: Tail stays at upper WATCH through the remaining holiday break. The principal conditional danger window is the 22:00 UTC reopen through early post-reopen price discovery; elevated Tail requires an unrepaired directional gap, shallow or failed retracements, and repeated extension.
